description.p: Habit helps you build routines and stay consistent. Check off your habits each day, see how you are doing over time, and keep going.
Everything stays on your computer. There are no accounts, no internet access and no tracking.

ul.li: Check off habits for today and the last few days
Set rest days so planned breaks do not hurt your progress
Track goals with numbers, such as glasses of water or pages read
See your progress as a score, a curve and a calendar of past days
Fix days you forgot to log
Pick a color for each habit
Create a backup file and restore it any time
